name: Dodge Falling Rocks

meta.name: Dodge Falling Rocks
meta.tagline: Read the falling rocks and find a safe path.
meta.description: Move along the bottom of the arena to avoid falling rocks. The storm gets faster and denser as you survive, so watch the rocks' positions and drift to choose a safe lane.

rewardTerms.description: Fraction of the goal duration survived, increasing each safe step.
Average clearance from rocks predicted to reach the player's lane soon.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Balance staying alive with keeping a safe distance from incoming rocks.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Favor maintaining generous clearance from danger.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to dodge.
